about: What each edition this build recognises is made of: the file that boots it, the directory it is installed in, every file it ships, the configuration file it is launched with (required by name), and the optional documents an enhancement is gated on. Facts only - a name, a size and a SHA-256 (CONTRIBUTING.md). docs/hosts.md section 5 is the format. This file is the table: hosts/common builds its C++ from it and the release attaches it beside manifest.json, so nothing spells any of it twice.

editions.name: Curse of the Azure Bonds, as sold on Steam
editions.about: The Steam release, which identifies itself as v1.3: installed in a CURSE directory and saving in the SAVE directory inside it, with the Tandy sound chip. It ships saved games A and B, which are the player's and not artifacts.

editions.name: Curse of the Azure Bonds, as sold on GOG
editions.about: The GOG release: every program and data file byte-identical to Steam's, installed at the root and saving in a SAVE directory there, with the PC speaker. It ships saved game A, which is the player's and not an artifact; only its configuration file as shipped tells it from Steam's.
